observations: White multifunction printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
HP logo is visible on the front left of the unit.
A promotional sticker for 'HP OfficeJet Pro 9010' is attached to the top.
The printer is sitting on a white plastic box.
The device appears to be in a used condition, consistent with a retail or office environment.

claims.evidence: This is a performance claim that cannot be verified from a static photo.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The color print heads may be clogged or the color cartridges may be empty.
risks.proof: A photo of a test print showing clear, vibrant color output.
risks.if_unproven: as a monochrome (black and white) printer

risks.risk: The machine may have a high total page count (TPO) indicating heavy prior use.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Status' or 'Toner' screen showing the page count.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the current page count on the device's display.
Photo of the toner and drum cartridges.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
